title: 第5章 啥玩意你说你叫万魂幡第6章 公主的挑衅
slug: 一剑惊天下可她身后的男人更可怕
content_zh:
房间里，烛火摇曳。
君傲盘膝坐在榻上，闭目凝神，《惊鸿诀》在体内缓缓运转。
一股股温热的气流顺着经脉游走……
那是今天杀了十几个鬼武者后，黑旗反哺的真气。
比昨夜浓郁得多，像细小的溪流，在他干涸了二十年的经脉里奔涌。
他很想继续。
很想一鼓作气，冲破武道第三境的壁垒，踏入第四境。
那种力量在体内滋长的感觉，像上瘾。
就在他催动真气，准备冲击经脉关隘时——
“小子，我劝你别这么干。”
一道声音毫无征兆地响起。
很苍老，很沙哑，像埋在土里千年的石头突然开口说话。
君傲浑身一僵，真气差点逆行。
他猛地睁眼：“谁？！”
“我。”
声音……是从气海里传来的。
君傲愣住了。
他意识沉入气海。
那面黑旗还悬在那里，但旗面微微飘动，像是在……呼吸？
“你……会说话？”君傲试探着问。

“笑话。”那声音带着浓浓的讥诮，“本尊可是至高无上的仙器，怎么就不会说话了？”
“仙器？”君傲更懵了，“你不是我从蓝星带过来的吗？怎么……”
“蓝星以前也有修行者。”黑旗打断他，语气有些不耐烦，“后来灵气枯竭，修行者都死绝了，只剩下些凡人。本尊被人遗忘在角落里，几千年没人动过，谁知道你这小子手贱，非要碰一下。”
君傲喉咙动了动：“所以你到底……是什么？”
“本尊名号——万魂幡。”
君傲脑子里“嗡”的一声。
万魂幡。
这三个字，他前世可太熟悉了。
传说中至邪至恶的法器，需以万千生魂血祭方能炼成，每杀一人，便能抽取其魂魄炼入幡中，化为己用。
“你……你是邪物？”君傲声音发紧。
“放屁！”万魂幡像是被踩了尾巴，“本尊是仙器！正儿八经的仙器！只不过……当年炼制时出了点岔子，需要用血气温养罢了。”
它顿了顿，语气忽然变得有些……委屈？
“你小子倒好，二十年来连只鸡都没杀过。本尊饿得前胸贴后背，再这么下去，怕是要退化回凡铁了！”
君傲：“……”
“幸好这两天你总算开了窍，杀的还是武道高阶的鬼子。”万魂幡语气转缓，“所以本尊给你的馈赠，也算丰厚。”
君傲忽然想到什么：“等等……你说馈赠？那反哺给我的真气……”
“是你杀的那些人一身血气所化。”万魂幡说得理所当然，“本尊抽走九成，剩下一成给你。”
君傲脸都绿了。
“你抽走九成！你这也太……”
“太什么？”万魂幡哼道，“没本尊，你连那一丝都没有。还有，以后本尊的抽成会增加到9.9999999999999％。”
content_en:
In the room, candlelight flickered.
Jun Ao sat cross-legged on the couch, closed his eyes and concentrated, and the "Jinghong Jue" was slowly running in his body.
Waves of warm air travel along the meridians...
That was the energy that Heiqi fed back after killing a dozen Onimusha today.
It was much richer than last night, like a small stream rushing through his meridians that had been dry for twenty years.
He was eager to continue.
I really want to work hard to break through the barriers of the third level of martial arts and step into the fourth level.
The feeling of power growing in the body is like an addiction.
Just when he mobilized his true energy and prepared to attack the meridian pass——
"Boy, I advise you not to do this."
A voice sounded without warning.
Very old, very hoarse, like a stone buried in the soil for thousands of years suddenly speaking.
Jun Ao froze, and his true energy almost went backwards.
He opened his eyes suddenly: "Who?!"
"Me."
The sound... came from the air sea.
Jun Ao was stunned.
His consciousness sank into the sea of ​​air.
The black flag was still hanging there, but it was fluttering slightly, as if it was...breathing?
"You... can talk?" Jun Ao asked tentatively.
"Joke." The voice was full of ridicule, "I am the supreme immortal weapon, why can't I speak?"
"Immortal weapon?" Jun Ao was even more confused, "Didn't I bring you here from Blue Star? Why..."
"There were practitioners in Blue Star before." Black Flag interrupted him with a somewhat impatient tone, "Later, the spiritual energy dried up and all the practitioners died, leaving only a few mortals. I was forgotten in a corner, and no one has touched it for thousands of years. Who knew that you, a brat, are so mean, you insist on touching me."
Jun Ao's throat moved: "So what exactly are you...?"
"My name - Ten Thousand Souls Banner."
Jun Ao's head buzzed.
Ten Thousand Souls Banner.
These three words were all too familiar to him in his previous life.
According to legend, the most evil magical weapon requires the blood sacrifice of thousands of souls to be refined. Every time a person is killed, his soul can be extracted and refined into the flag for his own use.
"You...are you an evil thing?" Jun Ao's voice was tight.
"Fart!" Wanhun Banner seemed to have had its tail stepped on, "I am an immortal weapon! A serious fairy weapon! It's just... there was something wrong during the refining process, and it needs to be nourished with blood and temperature."
It paused, and its tone suddenly became a little... aggrieved?
"It's good for you, kid. You haven't even killed a chicken in twenty years. I'm so hungry that my chest touches my back. If I continue like this, I'm afraid I will degenerate back to mortal iron!"
Jun Ao: "..."
"Fortunately, you have finally enlightened yourself in the past two days, and the ones you killed were still high-level martial arts devils." Wanhun Banner's tone softened, "So the gift I gave you is quite generous."
Jun Ao suddenly thought of something: "Wait a minute...you mean a gift? The energy that was given back to me..."
"They were transformed by the blood of those you killed." Wanhun Banner said matter-of-factly, "I will take away 90% and leave 10% to you."
Jun Ao's face turned green.
"You took away 90%! You are too..."
"What's too great?" Wanhun Banner snorted, "Without me, you don't even have that. Also, in the future, my commission will increase to 9.99999999999999%."
